lanes.name: Backoffice / Privileged Staff
lanes.hint: Configure and publish notifications and bulk notes

nodes.label: Submit Agent ID & Password
nodes.desc: The agent can submit Agent ID and password to log in to the system.

nodes.label: Role-Based View Rendered
nodes.desc: The System shall provide role-based view.

nodes.label: Initiate Profile Edit
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to initiate agent profile edit from the profile section.
controls: BR-01: Only agents granted profile-edit authority may update profile information, and they are accountable for the accuracy of the changes they submit.

nodes.label: Forgot Password
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to initiate forgotten password flow.

nodes.label: Verify Identity (Authcode/OTP)
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to verify himself by providing the necessary details (Authcode or OTP). Invalid or expired details are rejected with a validation message (no forward transition).

nodes.label: Create New Password
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to create the new password as per password policy. Non-compliant or mismatched entries are rejected with a validation message (no forward transition).

nodes.label: Change Password
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to change password by providing current password, new password, and confirm password.

nodes.label: Verify Identity for Password Change
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to identify himself for change password by providing necessary details (Authcode or OTP). Invalid or expired details prevent the change and display a validation message (no forward transition).

nodes.label: Update MFA Settings
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to change MFA settings with privileges.
controls: BR-02: An agent may request an MFA change only after identity verification and within the privileges approved by VFQ Security.

nodes.label: Verify Identity for MFA Settings
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to identify himself for MFA Settings by providing necessary details (Authcode or OTP). Invalid or expired details prevent the change and display a validation message (no forward transition).
controls: BR-02: An agent may request an MFA change only after identity verification and within the privileges approved by VFQ Security.

nodes.label: Change Language
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to change language from available options.

nodes.label: Save Profile Changes
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to save profile changes.

nodes.label: Profile Changes Saved
nodes.desc: Agent Profile status model: Saved — Profile changes are saved.

nodes.label: View Eligible Entities
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to navigate to view entities for which access is available.

nodes.label: Choose Entity Type
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to choose the entity type before export.

nodes.label: Export Visible Entities
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to export all visible entity records such as Orders, and Tickets.

nodes.label: Configure Bell Notification
nodes.desc: The Backoffice role shall be able to configure bell icon notification against a customer using the defined template and expiry date.
controls: BR-03: Only designated Backoffice or privileged staff may create or publish bell icon notifications and bulk notes.
BR-04: Staff publishing bell icon notifications or bulk notes must use an approved template and confirm the applicable customer or account context and expiry before publication.

nodes.label: Publish Notification Manually
nodes.desc: The privileged Agent shall be able to publish bell icon notifications manually using a defined format.
controls: BR-03: Only designated Backoffice or privileged staff may create or publish bell icon notifications and bulk notes.
BR-04: Staff publishing bell icon notifications or bulk notes must use an approved template and confirm the applicable customer or account context and expiry before publication.

nodes.label: View Bell Banner
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view the bell icon notification as a banner across Customer 360 screens.

nodes.label: Customer-Specific Notification Visibility
nodes.desc: The System shall display only customer account or MSISDN-specific notifications based on access permissions.

nodes.label: Sort Notifications
nodes.desc: The System shall sort customer notifications from latest to oldest.

nodes.label: No Manual Expiration
nodes.desc: The agent shall not be able to expire the bell icon notification manually.

nodes.label: Expire Notification
nodes.desc: The System shall remove bell icon notification after the preconfigured expiration interval.

nodes.label: Configure Bulk Notes
nodes.desc: The Backoffice role shall be able to configure bulk notes using a defined template.
controls: BR-03: Only designated Backoffice or privileged staff may create or publish bell icon notifications and bulk notes.
BR-04: Staff publishing bell icon notifications or bulk notes must use an approved template and confirm the applicable customer or account context and expiry before publication.

nodes.label: Apply Note to Multiple Accounts
nodes.desc: The System shall allow the same bulk note to be applied to multiple customer accounts.

nodes.label: View Bulk Notes
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view multiple notes pushed by the system with posting date and time.

nodes.label: Bulk Note Visibility Maintained
nodes.desc: The System shall display bulk notes irrespective of timeline after posting.

nodes.label: View Task Dashboard
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view task dashboard categories including Open Tasks, In Progress Tasks, Pending Payments, Priority Tasks, and Draft Orders.

nodes.label: Display Assigned Tasks
nodes.desc: The System shall display assigned tasks and priority tasks only for the logged-in agent.

nodes.label: Categorize Tasks
nodes.desc: The System shall categorize tasks based on priority and open task rules.

nodes.label: Supervisor Assigns Task
nodes.desc: The System shall allow only the supervisor to assign tasks to team members.
controls: BR-05: Only the responsible supervisor may assign or reassign tasks to members of the supervisor's team.

nodes.label: Navigate to Task Detail
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to navigate to detailed task view by selecting Open Tasks.

nodes.label: Update Task Status
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to move task status to In-progress or Close.

nodes.label: Task Closed
nodes.desc: Agent closes task.

nodes.label: Maintain Approval Matrix
nodes.desc: The System shall maintain a configured approval matrix for each task category.

nodes.label: View Assigned Approval Tasks
nodes.desc: The System shall display all approval tasks assigned to the specific agent.

nodes.label: Open Detailed Task View
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view the detailed view of the task by opening the task.

nodes.label: View Task History
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to see task history before confirming Approval, Rejection, or Return.

nodes.label: Approve / Reject / Return
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to approve, reject, or return an approval task.
controls: BR-06: Only the assigned approver may approve, reject, or return an approval task; rejection or return must include the applicable reason and supporting notes.

nodes.label: Add Approval Notes
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to add notes for approval task status Approved, Rejected, or Returned.
controls: BR-06: Only the assigned approver may approve, reject, or return an approval task; rejection or return must include the applicable reason and supporting notes.

nodes.label: Approval Task Approved
nodes.desc: Approver selects approve.

nodes.label: Approval Task Rejected
nodes.desc: Approver selects reject.

login_submit.title: Submit Agent ID & Password
login_submit.does: The agent submits Agent ID and password to log in.

role_view.title: Role-Based View Rendered
role_view.does: System renders views enabled or disabled based on the role matrix.
role_view.example: Acceptance Criteria: Views are enabled or disabled based on the role matrix (AGN-001-APM-01).

profile_edit_initiate.title: Initiate Profile Edit
profile_edit_initiate.does: Agent initiates profile edit from the profile section.
profile_edit_initiate.example: Acceptance Criteria: Edit profile option is available to the agent where role permits (AGN-001-APM-05).

forgot_password.title: Forgot Password
forgot_password.makes: Redirect to password setup with identification step
forgot_password.example: Acceptance Criteria: Forgot password directs the agent to password setup and supports the confirmed identification step (AGN-001-APM-02).

identify_password.title: Verify Identity (Authcode/OTP)
identify_password.does: Agent verifies identity by providing Authcode or OTP.
identify_password.makes: Verified identity or rejection with validation message
identify_password.example: Acceptance Criteria: Agent identity is successfully verified only when the required Authcode or OTP is valid; invalid or expired details are rejected with an appropriate validation message (AGN-001-APM-03).

create_new_password.title: Create New Password
create_new_password.does: Agent creates a new password per password policy.
create_new_password.example: Acceptance Criteria: A new password is accepted only when it complies with the configured password policy and matches the confirmation value; otherwise, a clear validation message is displayed (AGN-001-APM-04).

change_password.title: Change Password
change_password.does: Agent changes password by providing current, new, and confirm password.
change_password.needs: Current password, new password, confirm password
change_password.example: Acceptance Criteria: Password change is accepted only after successful login and after password policy validation (AGN-001-APM-06).

identify_change_password.title: Verify Identity for Password Change
identify_change_password.does: Agent identifies himself for password change via Authcode or OTP.
identify_change_password.makes: Verified proceed-to-change or blocked with validation message
identify_change_password.example: Acceptance Criteria: The agent can proceed to change Password Change only after successful verification using a valid Authcode or OTP; invalid or expired details prevent the change and display an appropriate validation message (AGN-001-APM-07).

update_mfa.title: Update MFA Settings
update_mfa.does: Agent changes MFA settings with privileges.
update_mfa.example: Acceptance Criteria: MFA status and authenticator/OTP setting can be updated only when permitted by role and security policy (AGN-001-APM-08).

identify_mfa.title: Verify Identity for MFA Settings
identify_mfa.does: Agent identifies himself for MFA settings via Authcode or OTP.
identify_mfa.makes: Verified proceed-to-change or blocked with validation message
identify_mfa.example: Acceptance Criteria: The agent can proceed to change MFA settings only after successful verification using a valid Authcode or OTP; invalid or expired details prevent the change and display an appropriate validation message (AGN-001-APM-07, MFA row).

change_language.title: Change Language
change_language.does: Agent changes language from available options.
change_language.example: Acceptance Criteria: English and/or Arabic options are available subject to VFQ confirmation (AGN-001-APM-09).

save_profile.title: Save Profile Changes
save_profile.does: System saves valid profile changes; rejects invalid changes.
save_profile.needs: Edited profile fields (password, MFA settings, language)
save_profile.makes: Persisted profile changes or rejection with validation message
save_profile.example: Acceptance Criteria: Valid profile changes are saved and invalid changes are rejected with validation message (AGN-001-APM-10).

profile_saved.title: Profile Changes Saved
profile_saved.does: Profile reaches Saved status after valid changes are saved.
profile_saved.makes: Agent Profile status = Saved (permitted next status: Edit Initiated)
profile_saved.example: Annex_02_Status_Model — Object: Agent Profile, Status: Saved, Trigger: Agent saves valid profile changes.

view_eligible_entities.title: View Eligible Entities
view_eligible_entities.does: Agent navigates to view entities for which access is available.
view_eligible_entities.makes: Entity list displayed per access rights
view_eligible_entities.example: Acceptance Criteria: Entity list displays as per access rights (AGN-001-AEX-01).

choose_entity_type.title: Choose Entity Type
choose_entity_type.does: Agent chooses the entity type before export.
choose_entity_type.example: Acceptance Criteria: Entity type values include Order, Ticket until VFQ confirms the complete list (AGN-001-AEX-03).

export_entities.title: Export Visible Entities
export_entities.does: Agent exports all visible entity records such as Orders and Tickets.
export_entities.makes: Export generated irrespective of assignment to logged-in agent
export_entities.example: Acceptance Criteria: Export can be generated for visible entities irrespective of whether they are assigned to the logged-in agent (AGN-001-AEX-02).

configure_bell.title: Configure Bell Notification
configure_bell.does: Backoffice role configures a bell icon notification against a customer using a defined template and expiry date.
configure_bell.example: Acceptance Criteria: Bell notification can be configured only by the permitted role (AGN-001-BIN-01).

publish_bell.title: Publish Notification Manually
publish_bell.does: Privileged agent publishes bell icon notifications manually using a defined format.
publish_bell.example: Acceptance Criteria: Notification can be created from a stored template and edited before publishing (AGN-001-BIN-02).

view_bell_banner.title: View Bell Banner
view_bell_banner.does: Agent views the bell icon notification as a banner across Customer 360 screens.
view_bell_banner.example: Acceptance Criteria: Notification banner is visible on Customer 360 for applicable account/MSISDN (AGN-001-BIN-03).

bell_visibility.title: Customer-Specific Notification Visibility
bell_visibility.does: System displays only customer account/MSISDN-specific notifications based on access permissions.
bell_visibility.makes: Filtered notification set for accessible customer account/MSISDN context
bell_visibility.example: Acceptance Criteria: Agent can view notifications only for accessible customer account/MSISDN context (AGN-001-BIN-04).

sort_bell.title: Sort Notifications
sort_bell.does: System sorts customer notifications from latest to oldest.
sort_bell.example: Acceptance Criteria: Notifications display in descending chronological order (AGN-001-BIN-05).

no_manual_expire.title: No Manual Expiration
no_manual_expire.does: Agent has no manual expire action available for bell icon notifications.
no_manual_expire.makes: Notification remains visible until configured expiry
no_manual_expire.example: Acceptance Criteria: No manual expire action is available to the agent; the bell icon notification remains visible until the configured expiry date or interval is reached, after which it is removed automatically (AGN-001-BIN-06).

expire_bell.title: Expire Notification
expire_bell.does: System removes bell icon notification after the preconfigured expiration interval.
expire_bell.example: Acceptance Criteria: Expired notification is no longer displayed after expiry rules are met (AGN-001-BIN-07). Status Model — Object: Bell Notification, Status: Expired, Trigger: Expiry interval reached.

configure_bulk_notes.title: Configure Bulk Notes
configure_bulk_notes.does: Backoffice role configures bulk notes using a defined template.
configure_bulk_notes.example: Acceptance Criteria: Only a permitted Backoffice user can create or configure a bulk note using an approved template; users without the required role cannot access or submit the configuration (AGN-001-BNT-04).

apply_bulk_note.title: Apply Note to Multiple Accounts
apply_bulk_note.does: System applies the same bulk note to multiple customer accounts.
apply_bulk_note.makes: Bulk note associated with one or more customer accounts
apply_bulk_note.example: Acceptance Criteria: A bulk note can be associated with one or more customer accounts (AGN-001-BNT-02).

view_bulk_notes.title: View Bulk Notes
view_bulk_notes.does: Agent views multiple notes pushed by the system with posting date and time.
view_bulk_notes.makes: Bulk notes displayed with associated date and time
view_bulk_notes.example: Acceptance Criteria: Bulk notes display with associated date and time (AGN-001-BNT-01).

bulk_note_posted.title: Bulk Note Visibility Maintained
bulk_note_posted.does: System displays bulk notes irrespective of timeline after posting.
bulk_note_posted.makes: Bulk note remains visible unless business confirms an expiry rule
bulk_note_posted.example: Acceptance Criteria: Posted bulk notes remain visible unless business confirms an expiry rule (AGN-001-BNT-03). Status Model — Object: Bulk Note, Status: Posted, Trigger: Bulk note upload/publish action.

view_task_dashboard.title: View Task Dashboard
view_task_dashboard.does: Agent views task dashboard categories: Open Tasks, In Progress Tasks, Pending Payments, Priority Tasks, Draft Orders.
view_task_dashboard.example: Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard shows all task categories (AGN-001-ATV-01).

display_assigned_tasks.title: Display Assigned Tasks
display_assigned_tasks.does: System displays assigned tasks and priority tasks only for the logged-in agent.
display_assigned_tasks.makes: Task records scoped to the logged-in agent
display_assigned_tasks.example: Acceptance Criteria: Logged-in agent sees only task records permitted for that agent (AGN-001-ATV-02).

categorize_tasks.title: Categorize Tasks
categorize_tasks.does: System categorizes tasks based on priority and open task rules.
categorize_tasks.example: Acceptance Criteria: Task appears in the correct category after business rules are configured (AGN-001-ATV-05).

supervisor_assign_task.title: Supervisor Assigns Task
supervisor_assign_task.does: Supervisor assigns tasks to team members; non-supervisors cannot.
supervisor_assign_task.example: Acceptance Criteria: Non-supervisor users cannot assign tasks to team members (AGN-001-ATV-03). Status Model — Object: Task, Status: Assigned, Trigger: Assignment.

navigate_task_detail.title: Navigate to Task Detail
navigate_task_detail.does: Agent navigates to detailed task view by selecting Open Tasks.
navigate_task_detail.example: Acceptance Criteria: Selecting a task opens the task detail page (AGN-001-ATV-04).

update_task_status.title: Update Task Status
update_task_status.does: Agent moves task status to In-progress or Close.
update_task_status.makes: Task status updated through permitted lifecycle transitions
update_task_status.example: Acceptance Criteria: Task status can be updated only through permitted lifecycle transitions (AGN-001-ATV-06). Status Model — Object: Task, Statuses: Open -> Assigned/In Progress/Closed; In Progress -> Closed.

task_closed.title: Task Closed
task_closed.makes: Task status = Closed (no further permitted next status)
task_closed.example: Annex_02_Status_Model — Object: Task, Status: Closed, Trigger: Agent status update.

approval_matrix.title: Maintain Approval Matrix
approval_matrix.does: System maintains a configured approval matrix for each task category.
approval_matrix.makes: Approval task assignment follows configured approval matrix
approval_matrix.example: Acceptance Criteria: Approval task assignment follows configured approval matrix (AGN-001-AAV-01).

view_assigned_approvals.title: View Assigned Approval Tasks
view_assigned_approvals.does: System displays all approval tasks assigned to the specific agent.
view_assigned_approvals.makes: Approval view showing tasks assigned to the logged-in agent
view_assigned_approvals.example: Acceptance Criteria: Approval view shows tasks assigned to the logged-in agent (AGN-001-AAV-02). Status Model — Object: Approval Task, Status: Pending Approval, Trigger: Approval task creation/assignment.

view_task_detail_approval.title: Open Detailed Task View
view_task_detail_approval.does: Agent opens the task to view its detailed view.
view_task_detail_approval.makes: Task detail view with all configured fields, or access denied
view_task_detail_approval.example: Acceptance Criteria: When the agent selects and opens an assigned approval task, the system displays the task detail view with all configured fields for that task; if the task is not assigned or accessible to the agent, access is denied (unlabeled row under #7 Agent Approval View).

view_task_history.title: View Task History
view_task_history.does: Agent sees task history before confirming Approval, Rejection, or Return.
view_task_history.makes: Task history: Task ID, Task Name, Action Taken, Date Time Stamp
view_task_history.example: Acceptance Criteria: Task history displays Task ID, Task Name, Action Taken, and Date Time Stamp (AGN-001-AAV-05).

approve_reject_return.title: Approve / Reject / Return
approve_reject_return.does: Agent approves, rejects, or returns an approval task.
approve_reject_return.makes: Task status updated per workflow; notes recorded where required
approve_reject_return.example: Acceptance Criteria: Approval action updates task status as per workflow and records notes where required (AGN-001-AAV-03).

add_approval_notes.title: Add Approval Notes
add_approval_notes.does: Agent adds notes for approval task status Approved, Rejected, or Returned.
add_approval_notes.makes: Approval notes captured with the approval action
add_approval_notes.example: Acceptance Criteria: Approval notes are captured with the approval action (AGN-001-AAV-04). Status Model — Object: Approval Task, Status: Returned, Permitted Next Status: Pending Approval.

approval_approved.title: Approval Task Approved
approval_approved.makes: Approval Task status = Approved (no further permitted next status)
approval_approved.example: Annex_02_Status_Model — Object: Approval Task, Status: Approved, Trigger: Approver selects approve.

approval_rejected.title: Approval Task Rejected
approval_rejected.makes: Approval Task status = Rejected (no further permitted next status)
approval_rejected.example: Annex_02_Status_Model — Object: Approval Task, Status: Rejected, Trigger: Approver selects reject.
